sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Salil Krishna,Amarendra Mani
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
Heard Mr. Salil Krishna, the learned counsel for applicant and the learned A.G.A. for State.

Challenge in this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is to the Charge Sheet No. 154A of 2020 dated 30.05.2020 submitted in Case Crime No. 0023 of 2020 under Sections 419, 420 IPC and Sections 6/10, The Uttar Pradesh Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998,
Police Station-Mardhah, District-Ghazipur, the Cognizance Taking Order/Summoning Order dated 29.06.2020 passed by Juvenile Justice Board, Ghazipur in Case No. 111 of 2020 (State Vs. Amit Kumar) under Sections419, 420 IPC and Sections 6/10, The Uttar Pradesh Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998, Police Station-Mardhah, District-Ghazipur, as well as the entire proceedings of aforementioned criminal case now pending in the court of Juvenile Justice Board, Ghazipur.
Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118813472/

entities.text: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. has raised a preliminary objection by submitting that present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is not maintainable.
Remedy of applicant is to file an appeal in terms of Section 101 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
As such,
present application is not maintainable.
Same is liable to be dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.
When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant could not over come the same.
As a result, present application fails and is liable to be dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.
It is accordingly dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.
Certified copy of the impugned order shall be returned to the learned counsel for applicant after obtaining a photo copy of the same to be kept on record.
